描述_EN: a resist substance such as wax would allow coloured glazes to adhere to selected parts of the surface of the jar, thus forming the desired pattern. the decoration of small rosettes was achieved with the resist method. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was probably a funerary piece, as lead-glazed vessels could poison the user.
描述_ZN: 蜡等抗蚀物质可以使彩色釉料粘附在罐子表面的选定部分，从而形成所需的图案。 小花冠的装饰是用抗蚀法实现的。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子可能是一件殉葬品，因为铅釉器皿会使使用者中毒。
